main_text.p: [Syriac] Syr. Idem. Plur. [Syriac] Principes, Gr. Ἀρχοντες, Act. 4.26. Potestates, ἐξουσίαι, ad Coloss.2.15. 1. Petr.3.22.
[Hebrew] Chal. Dominatio, dominium, potestas, Jesa.9.3. Item Dominus, dominator. Plur. [Hebrew].
[Hebrew] Chal. & Syr. Idem. Plural. [Hebrew]: [Syriac] Potestates, ad Coloss.1.16. & 2.10.
[Hebrew] Ch. Scuta, Umbones, ut Hebr. Jerem.51. 11.2.Sam.8.7. German. Schilt. Item Maculae pardi, quòd similes sint scutis, scutula, Jerem.13.23.
[Hebrew] Hebr. Spoliari. Hinc [Hebrew] Ch. Praedae, spolia, Esth.3.13.
[Hebrew] Ch. Embryo, Foetus matricis, nondum in lucem editus, Eccles.6.3. Item Abortivum, Deut. 14.7. in Jonath.

[Hebrew] Chal. & Syr. Absolvere, implere, complere: Absolvi, impleri, compleri, consummari, perfici, finiri, consumi, deficere. Deinde Syr. quoq; significet Finire vitam, mori, exspirare, [Syriac] Et expiravit, mortuus est, Mar.15.37. Luc.23.46. Pacem habere vel colere, pace, prosperitate frui: Pacificū, concordem esse, consentire. Syr. Part. [Syriac] Non consenserat Lucæ 23.51: ad Rom.7.21. Plur. fœm. [Syriac] Consentiunt, Act. 15.15.
